packets.title: Clean Compliant Submission
packets.storyline: Ideal applicant submission where all documents are present, identity fields match across certificates, income falls within statutory thresholds, and bank IFSC is verified.
packets.key_talking_point: Demonstrates high-confidence green path: sub-2s offline extraction, 100 score, cross-document field reconciliation.

packets.title: Critical Applicant Name Mismatch
packets.storyline: High-risk failure mode where the applicant name on the marksheet differs from the government application form due to typographic substitution.

expected_outcome.human_action: Correct marksheet or application name before submission.

packets.key_talking_point: Demonstrates fatal defect detection: instantaneous red alert, side-by-side evidence navigation with exact bounding boxes, and strict human override blocking.

packets.title: Missing Mandatory Caste Certificate
packets.storyline: Applicant claims caste reservation quota but omits the mandatory caste certificate from the upload packet.

expected_outcome.human_action: Upload valid Caste Certificate before proceeding.

packets.key_talking_point: Demonstrates negative evidence handling: clean absence callout without hallucinated coordinates, exact statutory clause citation.

packets.title: Ambiguous Evidence & Human Review Boundary
packets.storyline: Edge-case submission with single-letter initials in bank passbook and ambiguous date format (DD/MM vs MM/DD) on marksheet.

expected_outcome.human_action: Operator manually inspects initials and ambiguous date before clearing.

packets.key_talking_point: Demonstrates calibrated human-in-the-loop review: neither false rejection nor false clearance; targeted bounding boxes guide rapid verification.

packets.title: Degraded / Unreadable Document Abstention
packets.storyline: Upload packet contains a heavily blurred, corrupted, or low-contrast income certificate where text characters cannot be reliably resolved.

expected_outcome.human_action: Operator requests clear re-scan from applicant.

packets.key_talking_point: Demonstrates conservative AI safety: abstains when evidence is degraded instead of hallucinating OCR text or asserting false compliance.
